pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.0.2: Ime kho panāyasmanto dvenavuti pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Hatthako Sakyaputto vādakkhitto hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.3: so titthiyehi saddhiṃ sallapento avajānitvā paṭijānāti paṭijānitvā avajānāti aññen' aññaṃ paṭicarati sampajānamusā bhāsati saṃketaṃ katvā visaṃvādeti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.4: titthiyā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti: kathaṃ hi nāma Hatthako Sakyaputto amhehi saddhiṃ sallapento avajānitvā paṭijānissati paṭijānitvā avajānissati aññen' aññaṃ paṭicarissati sampajānamusā bhāsissati saṃketaṃ katvā visaṃvādessatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ titthiyānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.6: atha kho te bhikkhū yena Hatthako Sakyaputto ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā Hatthakaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.7: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ āvuso Hatthaka titthiyehi saddhiṃ sallapento avajānitvā paṭijānāsi . . . visaṃvādesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.8: ete kho āvuso titthiyā nāma yena kenaci jetabbā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.10: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma Hatthako Sakyaputto titthiyehi saddhiṃ sallapento avajānitvā paṭijānissati paṭijānitvā avajānissati aññen' aññaṃ paṭicarissati sampajānamusā bhāsissati saṃketaṃ katvā visaṃvādessatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.12: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.13: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā Hatthakaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.14: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Hatthaka titthiyehi saddhiṃ sallapento avajānitvā paṭijānāsi . . . bhāsasi saṃketaṃ katvā visaṃvādesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.17: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa titthiyehi saddhiṃ sallapento avajānitvā paṭijānissasi . . . bhāsissasi saṃketaṃ katvā visaṃvādessasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.18: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:1.19: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.1.2: visaṃvādanapurekkhārassa vācā girā byappattho vacībhedo vācasikā viññatti anariyavohārā: adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhaṃ me 'ti, asutaṃ sutaṃ me 'ti, amutaṃ mutaṃ me 'ti, aviññātaṃ viññātaṃ me 'ti, diṭṭhaṃ adiṭṭhaṃ me 'ti, sutaṃ asutaṃ me 'ti, mutaṃ amutaṃ me 'ti, viññātaṃ aviññātaṃ me 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.1.8: na ghānena ghāyitaṃ na jivhāya sāyitaṃ na kāyena phuṭṭhaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.1.16: ghānena ghāyitaṃ jivhāya sāyitaṃ kāyena phuṭṭhaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.2.1: tīh' ākārehi adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhaṃ me 'ti sampajānamusā bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.2.2: pubbev' assa hotimusā bhaṇissan ti, bhaṇantassa hoti musā bhaṇāmīti, bhaṇitassa hoti musā mayā bhaṇitan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.2.3: catūh' ākārehi adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhaṃ me 'ti sampajānamusā bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.2.4: pubbev' assa hoti musā bhaṇissan ti, bhaṇantassa hoti musā bhaṇāmīti, bhaṇitassa hoti musā mayā bhaṇitan ti, vinidhāya diṭṭhiṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.2.6: musā mayā bhaṇitan ti, vinidhāya diṭṭhiṃ, vinidhāya khantiṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.2.8: bhaṇitan ti, vinidhāya diṭṭhiṃ, vinidhāya khantiṃ, vinidhāya ruciṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.2.10: bhaṇitan ti, vinidhāya diṭṭhiṃ, vinidhāya khantiṃ, vinidhāya ruciṃ, vinidhāya bhāvaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.2.13: aviññātaṃ viññātaṃ me 'ti sampajānamusā bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.2.14: pubbev' assa hoti musā bhaṇissan ti, bhaṇantassa hoti musā bhaṇāmīti, bhaṇitassa hoti musā mayā bhaṇitan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.3.1: tīh' ākārehi adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhañ ca me sutañ cā 'ti sampajānamusā bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.3.2: tīh' ākārehi adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhañ ca me mutañ cā 'ti . . . adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhañ ca me viññātañ cā 'ti . . . adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhañ ca me sutañ ca mutañ cā 'ti . . . adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhañ ca me sutañ ca viññātañ cā 'ti . . . adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhañ ca me sutañ ca mutañ ca viññātañ cā 'ti sampajānamusā bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa. tīhi ākārehi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.3.3: asutaṃ sutañ ca me mutañ cā 'ti . . . asutaṃ sutañ ca me viññātañ cā 'ti . . . asutaṃ sutañ ca me diṭṭhañ cā 'ti . . ., . . . asutaṃ sutañ ca me mutañ ca viññātañ ca diṭṭhañ cā 'ti sampajānamusā bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa. tīhi ākārehi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.3.4: amutaṃ mutañ ca me viññātañ cā 'ti . . ., . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.3.6: viññātañ ca diṭṭhañ ca sutañ cā 'ti sampajānamusā bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa. tīhi ākārehi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.3.7: aviññātaṃ viññātañ ca me diṭṭhañ cā 'ti . . ., . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.3.8: aviññātaṃ viññātañ ca me diṭṭhañ ca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.3.9: sutañ ca mutañ cā 'ti sampajānamusā bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa. ||3|| tīhi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.4.4: viññātaṃ aviññātaṃ me 'ti sampajānamusā bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa. ||4|| tīhi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.5.3: diṭṭhaṃ viññātaṃ me 'ti sampajānamusā bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa. tīhi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.5.4: ākārehi diṭṭhaṃ sutañ ca me mutañ cā 'ti . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.5.5: diṭṭhaṃ sutañ ca me viññātañ cā 'ti . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.5.6: diṭṭhaṃ sutañ ca me mutañ ca viññātañ cā 'ti . . ., . . . viññātaṃ diṭṭhañ ca me sutañ ca mutañ cā 'ti sampajānamusā bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa. ||5|| tīhi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.6.1: diṭṭhe vematiko diṭṭhaṃ n' okappeti diṭṭhaṃ na ssarati diṭṭhaṃ sammuṭṭho hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.6.2: sute vematiko sutaṃ n' okappeti sutaṃ na ssarati sutaṃ sammuṭṭho hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.6.4: viññāte vematiko . . . viññātaṃ sammuṭṭho hoti viññātañ ca me diṭṭhañ cā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.6.5: viññātaṃ sammuṭṭho hoti viññātañ ca me sutañ cā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.6.6: viññātaṃ sammuṭṭho hoti viññātañ ca me mutañ cā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.6.7: viññātaṃ sammuṭṭho hoti viññātañ ca me diṭṭhañ ca sutañ cā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.6.8: viññātaṃ sammuṭṭho hoti viññātañ ca me diṭṭhañ ca mutañ cā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.6.9: viññātaṃ sammuṭṭho hoti viññātañ ca me diṭṭhañ ca sutañ ca mutañ cā 'ti sampajānamusā bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.6.13: sattah' ākārehi viññātaṃ sammuṭṭho hoti viññātañ ca me diṭṭhañ ca sutañ ca mutañ cā 'ti sampajānamusā bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc1:2.6.14: pubbev' assa hoti musā bhaṇissan ti, bhaṇantassa hoti musā bhaṇāmīti, bhaṇitassa hoti musā mayā bhaṇitan ti, vinidhāya diṭṭhiṃ, vinidhāya khantiṃ, vinidhāya ruciṃ, vinidhāya bhāvaṃ. ||6||
